Who we are
Bag
Kōrin EK-S Burr Unit, SSP-HG 64

Flat-burr grind engine with a 64 mm SSP-HG set and a dial for the bench.

Built in small batches at our Lviv workshop. Each unit is checked by hand before it leaves the bench, and the glaze differs slightly from piece to piece.

Care: rinse with warm water. Avoid abrupt temperature change.

What is in the box

The set, a cloth pouch, and a card with our brewing notes.
